detailedExplanation: All objects emit and absorb infrared radiation. Hotter objects generally emit infrared radiation at a greater rate.
Surface properties matter. At the school level, dark, matt surfaces are good absorbers and emitters of infrared; light, shiny surfaces are poorer absorbers/emitters and better reflectors.
